source_title: India heads for record crude imports in October as refiners secure supplies - Business Standard
source_excerpt: Despite a squeeze in vessel availability for crude oil imports and heavy losses on fuel sales, state-run and private sector refiners led by Indian Oil and Reliance Industries are on course in October to send India’s crude oil imports to an all-time high, ensuring supply security in a country with 90 per cent dependence on foreign oil, according to exclusive ship-tracking data accessed by Business Standard and senior refining officials.
